memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: The sixth lot came out for Naphtali according to its clans: Their boundary went from Heleph and the large tree in Zaanannim, passing Adami Nekeb and Jabneel to Lakkum and ending at the Jordan. The boundary ran west through Aznoth Tabor and came out at Hukkok. It touched Zebulun on the south, Asher on the west and the Jordan on the east - Josh 19:32-34 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The sixth lot falls to Naphtali, in the beautiful hill country of the far north, bordering the Sea of Galilee. Jacob had spoken tenderly of this tribe: "Naphtali is a doe set free that bears beautiful fawns" (Gen 49:21) — an image of freedom, grace, and gladness. Naphtali's land was a place of natural beauty, and this tribe carried a blessing of liberty and joy.

Naphtali's territory, like Zebulun's, would become part of the region where Jesus carried out much of His ministry. The Sea of Galilee, around which so many of Jesus' miracles and teachings took place, bordered this very land. Once again, the light foretold by Isaiah for these northern regions would dawn here in the person of Christ (Isa 9:1-2). Naphtali's portion was quietly being prepared as ground where the Saviour would walk.

There is joy woven into Naphtali's story — the freedom of a doe set loose, the beauty of the land, and ultimately the coming of the One who brings true freedom and joy. Jesus said that whoever the Son sets free is free indeed (John 8:36), and that His joy might be in us and our joy be complete (John 15:11). The freedom pictured in Naphtali finds its fullness in Christ. Whatever binds us, He offers liberty; whatever steals our gladness, He offers a joy that endures. The doe set free points us to the freedom found in the Saviour who walked Naphtali's shores.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Where do you long for the freedom and joy pictured in Naphtali?
- How does Jesus' promise of true freedom meet that longing?
- What would it mean to receive His joy as your own today?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord Jesus, You are the One who sets us truly free and fills us with lasting joy. Where I feel bound or joyless, bring me the freedom and gladness that are found in You alone. Amen.
